planned_only.name: EtherCAT servo retrofit planned only
planned_only.source_line: LinuxCNC Forum member Beovoxo reports acquiring a used Deckel FP4A mill and planning a full EtherCAT servo retrofit. The original control unit and electrical cabinet were removed. The owner installed LinuxCNC on an IBM M78 computer and later reported getting a Beckhoff EK1100 running under LinuxCNC EtherCAT. By February 2025, the plan was for the EtherCAT I/O to control transmission functions, while the CX unit might serve as a conventional PLC. The inspected thread does not establish that the mill was fully commissioned.
